note:
The coach DEPARTING, with its wheels turning. Eight frames: each wheel rotated by the fraction of a revolution that its own radius makes over the same ground, so the rear (r144) and front (r114) turn at DIFFERENT rates. That difference is what makes it read as rolling rather than spinning.

It was one frame identical to `idle`, so the coach slid off frame with its wheels frozen. The wheels were cut and rotatable in art/objects/coach/ the whole time and nothing drove them.

THE HORSES' LEGS STILL DO NOT MOVE. They are drawn inside the body and overlap each other, so a leg cycle needs painted masks or new art. Recorded rather than hidden.
